subject: Brightport pilot — alternate billing path for short trial
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightport.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question: onboarding for 30-day pilot without PO?

Hi Michael,

We're gearing up for a 30-day integration pilot of Redwood for Brightport's search assistant. The pilot budget is $11,750 and finance asked whether we can do a short trial under an invoice-only arrangement rather than issuing a formal PO. Procurement here typically requires a PO for longer-term contracts, but they said small pilots sometimes go via invoice if the vendor supports it.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only billing for this pilot? If so, what evidence (SOW, vendor questionnaire, docs) do you need from us so procurement can approve quickly? We're trying to start week of Apr 12.

Thanks,

Samantha Ortiz
Procurement Manager
Brightport Inc.
attachments: Brightport_SOW_v1.pdf; Brightport_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightport.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question: onboarding for 30-day pilot without PO?

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you and excited for the pilot.

Short answer: we can make a limited invoice-only path for short pilots with a couple of guardrails.

Proposed conditions:
- Pilot term: 30 days starting on sign of SOW
- Maximum invoiced amount: $12,500 (covers your $11,750)
- Signed SOW and completed vendor questionnaire on file
- Standard Redwood pilot addendum signed (limits scope + termination right)
- Finance sends payment terms (Net30) and remittance details

Next steps I can own from our side:
1) I'll add a short pilot addendum and return a countersigned SOW once your team completes the questionnaire.
2) Priyom (account) can open a HubSpot record and a DocuSign envelope to streamline signatures.
3) Lauren (procurement) — can you confirm whether we need procurement board approval for this size? If so, can you kick that off once the questionnaire's in?

If that works, Samantha, please return the questionnaire and I'll attach the pilot addendum.

Best,

Michael Grant
Account Lead — Strategic
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-pilot-approval-note.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question: onboarding for 30-day pilot without PO?

Michael / Priyom —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement's current tolerance for invoice-only is limited but we can sign off on exceptions for low-risk, short pilots.

Requirements from procurement/legal to approve an invoice-only exception:
- Completed vendor questionnaire (already requested)
- W-9 (or equivalent) on file
- Proof of SOC 2 or security attestation OR completion of our short security checklist
- SOW with explicit pilot scope, limits, and termination clauses
- Contract value under $15k (this qualifies)

If all of the above are present, I can route to exceptions board and typically we have a 24–48 hour turnaround. Please mark the request as "pilot - low risk" and include the HubSpot deal ID so I can attach to the approval. I'll also want a copy of the invoice template Brightport will use.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightport.io>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question: onboarding for 30-day pilot without PO?

Hi Samantha — thanks. To keep things moving, here's a quick mutual action plan (MAP):

Brightport:
- Complete vendor questionnaire (attached)
- Sign SOW + pilot addendum (DocuSign link below)
- Provide W-9 and invoice remittance details

Redwood:
- Circulate pilot addendum and countersign once questionnaire + W-9 are received
- Procurement (Lauren) will route the exception to the board with our recommendation
- Account team (me + Michael) will coordinate kickoff and technical onboarding

DocuSign (SOW + pilot addendum): https://secure.redwood.com/docusign/BR-5421-SOW
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BR-5421

If Brightport can return the questionnaire and W-9 by Apr 7 we should be able to sign and start the week of Apr 12. Priyom — I'll track approvals. Samantha, happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightport.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question: onboarding for 30-day pilot without PO?

Samantha — quick update after procurement review.

Procurement has provisionally approved an invoice-only path for this pilot under the conditions Lauren listed. Final sign-off is pending the completed questionnaire and W-9, and our team will need the signed SOW before the start date.

Approved parameters:
- Pilot cap: $12,500
- Term: 30 days
- Payment: Invoice, Net30
- Controls: SOW + pilot addendum on file, security attestation or checklist completed

I'll attach the pilot addendum and a short approval note (for your finance team). Priyom will send the DocuSign envelope; please upload your W-9 to the DocuSign or send to procurement directly.

Next step: Samantha, can you confirm you will return the questionnaire + W-9 by Apr 7? If so, we'll queue signatures and confirm kickoff.

Cheers,

Michael Grant
Account Lead — Strategic
Redwood Inference
